outlandish.ponder.ae2_gtceu_automation.t: AE2 can help manage the large number of materials produced by your industrial factory.
GTCEu machinery still requires correct electrical power, item routing and fluid handling.
Keep intermediate materials available so your processing network does not run out of essential components.
Early factories often rely on manual inventory management.
An ME Drive stores ME cells that hold items within your network.
Provide compatible electrical energy to power the network.
The blocks illustrate the move from ordinary storage to a powered ME system.
Attach compatible AE2 cables and terminals to access the network.
Once you establish stable power and storage, begin planning industrial automation.
A storage network does not automatically control GTCEu machines.
For automated crafting and processing, use the appropriate AE2 patterns and interfaces with compatible machine connections.
outlandish.ponder.ae2_power_storage.head: AE2: Keeping Your ME Network Running
outlandish.ponder.ae2_power_storage.text: A stable ME Network needs electrical power, storage cells and enough internal energy capacity.
The ME Storage Cells inside the Drive determine the amount and types of items you can store.
A small network can run without an ME Controller, but its available channels are limited.
For larger GTCEu factories, expand the network carefully and monitor power, storage and channels.
An ME Network is a valuable foundation for future automated industrial processing.
Step 1: Place an Energy Acceptor and connect an appropriate external power source.
Step 2: Add an AE2 Energy Cell to buffer the network against power demand spikes.
Step 3: Attach an ME Drive to the network.
Place suitable ME Storage Cells inside the Drive to provide actual item storage.
Step 4: Run an ME Cable from the Drive toward your terminal.
Attach an ME Terminal or Crafting Terminal to the cable, facing outward.
AE2 terminals are cable-mounted parts, so they are not shown here as ordinary full blocks.
The Energy Cell stores network energy. It does not store items.
outlandish.ponder.ae2_processor_crafting: AE2 uses processors to craft many network components. The Inscriber is an essential manufacturing machine.
The Inscriber supports automation through configured item insertion and extraction.
When automating processors, make sure printed components are routed to the correct inputs.
Build a reliable processor supply before expanding AE2 storage, terminals and autocrafting.
Step 1: Place an Inscriber and supply compatible electrical power.
Insert the appropriate Inscriber Press and its matching material.
Logic, Calculation and Engineering processors each require their own corresponding printed component.
A Silicon Press is used to prepare Printed Silicon.
Step 2: Redstone is one of the ingredients used when assembling standard AE2 processors.
Combine the appropriate printed component, Printed Silicon and Redstone in the Inscriber.
The Redstone Block is only an ingredient reminder, not a machine connection.
Use JEI to inspect the exact press arrangement and ingredients for each processor.
outlandish.ponder.alloy_production.text_: Alloys combine materials into metals and compounds needed for advanced machines.
Gather the required base materials. The ingredients depend on your chosen alloy.
The Alloy Smelter combines compatible ingredients into new products.
Store finished alloys separately from raw materials.
Use JEI to select the exact alloy recipe and check its required machine tier.
Some materials are made by mixing dusts, while other products need blast processing or additional machines.
An Alloy Smelter cannot replace every metallurgy machine.
Create and Tinkers remain part of our early workshop progression. Follow the questbook before changing processing methods.
Prepare alloy reserves before advancing to new voltage tiers.
outlandish.ponder.bloodmagic_gtceu.text_: Blood Magic in Outlandish Revelations is connected to Create and GTCEu technology.
As your GTCEu voltage progression advances, additional ritual materials and crafting stages become available.
Use JEI for exact recipes rather than assuming standard Blood Magic ingredients.
The Blood Altar is the center of your ritual crafting.
Create steam is an early technological milestone for the magic progression.
GTCEu processing and electrical tiers support later Blood Magic advancements.
The blocks represent connected progression systems. They are not meant to touch in an actual build.
Some Blood Magic recipes require specially prepared industrial components.
These may include infused circuits, ritual control components and chemical catalysts.
Your altar still needs Life Essence for applicable recipes. Technology does not replace LP.
Check the Blood Magic quest chapter for your current unlock requirements.
A Mana Pool stores mana and can transform suitable ingredients through mana infusion.
Use JEI to determine which ingredients, catalysts and mana requirements apply.
Mana infusion supports magical crafting, but does not replace the industrial progression in Outlandish Revelations.
Begin by preparing an area for mana generation.
Generating flowers such as Endoflames convert their appropriate fuel into mana.
A Mana Spreader collects nearby generated mana and sends it as mana bursts.
Position your Mana Pool where it can receive mana from the spreader.
Use the Wand of the Forest to aim the spreader at the pool and check mana connections.
Once mana is stored, drop a valid infusion ingredient into the Mana Pool.
If the pool contains sufficient mana and the recipe is valid, the ingredient transforms.
Some advanced infusion recipes require a special catalyst beneath the Mana Pool.
Botania: Crafting with the Runic Altar
Runic crafting transforms ingredients and mana into magical runes.
The result is your crafted rune. Different runes require different materials.
Check JEI and the Botania quest chapter for recipes and progression.
Step 1: Prepare a Mana Pool containing enough mana for the recipe.
Step 2: Position a Mana Spreader to transfer mana toward the altar.
Step 3: Place a Runic Altar where mana bursts can reach it.
Aim the Mana Spreader at the Runic Altar using the Wand of the Forest.
Insert or drop the required recipe ingredients onto the altar.
The Runic Altar consumes mana while processing a valid recipe.
Watch the altar for the completion effects indicating sufficient mana has been supplied.
Place or throw Livingrock onto the completed altar, then use the Wand of the Forest.
outlandish.ponder.build_first_melter.hea: Tinkers Workshop: Building Your First Melter
outlandish.ponder.build_first_melter.tex: Before a full smeltery, construct a compact melting and casting station.
Step 1: Place a Seared Heater as your foundation.
Step 2: Place the Seared Melter directly on top of the heater.
Step 3: Position the Casting Table beside the heater, one block lower than the melter.
Step 4: Attach a faucet to the melter, facing the Casting Table.
The heater needs fuel. Insert materials into the melter and use the faucet to pour.
Create materials are part of our workshop progression. Check JEI before crafting the components.
Use the casting table for casts and tool parts. A Casting Basin is used for larger castings.
outlandish.ponder.build_power_transmissi: Create: Connecting Your First Power Network
A Create machine needs a connected source of rotational power.
Step 1: Install a Water Wheel near a suitable flowing-water arrangement.
Step 2: Connect a Shaft to the axle of the wheel.
Step 3: Extend the shaft line toward the machinery you want to operate.
Shafts transfer rotational power in a straight line. Their axis must align.
Use cogwheels and gearboxes when the power network needs to turn a corner.
Check both rotational speed and stress capacity. A connected machine can still be overstressed.
This is your foundation for presses, mixers, crushing equipment and later automation.
outlandish.ponder.build_steam_boiler.hea: Create: Building a Steam Power System
outlandish.ponder.build_steam_boiler.tex: Steam engines need a boiler, heat, a steady supply of water and a rotational output.
Step 7: Attach a Steam Engine to the boiler.
Click the engine with a Shaft to create its rotational output.
Engineer Goggles reveal whether boiler size, heat or water supply limits the system.
Once steam power is established, continue toward the next GTCEu progression milestones.
Step 1: Place the first Fluid Tank.
Step 2: Add another tank alongside it.
The boiler requires heat beneath its tank columns. Stronger heat permits greater output.
Step 5: Position a Blaze Burner beneath a boiler column.
Step 6: Add heating beneath the other column.
Supply the boiler with water using pipes and a Mechanical Pump.
outlandish.ponder.chemical_processing.te: Chemical processing becomes increasingly important as your factory develops.
The LV through IV chemistry quest chapters guide you toward progressively more complex materials.
Chemical recipes can require item ingredients and measured quantities of fluids.
The Chemical Reactor handles compatible reactions at its supported voltage tier.
Plan separate storage for fluid products. This cauldron is only a visual marker.
Read the JEI recipe carefully. Check all ingredients, fluid quantities, duration and EU/t.
Different processing stages may require electrolyzers, centrifuges, distilleries or other machines.
Never assume a chemical reaction produces only one output. Byproducts may need extraction.
A full output tank or slot can prevent a production line from continuing.
Some advanced chemistry processes require higher-tier machinery or multiblocks.
Circuits are essential for advancing into more powerful GTCEu equipment.
Circuit manufacturing starts with the components specified by your recipe.
The Circuit Assembler combines multiple ingredients into electronic components.
Keep completed circuits and intermediate materials organized.
Check JEI for the ingredients, required voltage, machine configuration and any fluid inputs.
The Circuit Assembler accepts recipes with several item inputs. Prepare reliable ingredient delivery.
Some advanced circuits require components from chemical processing or other machines.
Do not automatically upgrade every production line when a higher voltage tier becomes available.
Our Blood Magic integration also introduces special circuit-related materials. Follow its dedicated quests.
outlandish.ponder.create_bulk_processing: An Encased Fan can process multiple items using airflow and the correct processing medium.
Check JEI for the exact bulk-processing method and ingredients.
Fans are excellent for automating repeated material-processing tasks before and alongside GTCEu machinery.
Step 1: Place an Encased Fan with its airflow directed toward your processing area.
Step 2: Supply rotational power to the fan through a correctly aligned drivetrain.
The fan must be rotating. Use a rotational power source and confirm the airflow direction.
Step 3: Water in the airflow path enables compatible bulk-washing recipes.
Place eligible items in the processing airflow using a Depot, Belt or other suitable method.
Bulk washing recipes are different from ordinary crafting and smelting recipes.
Heated airflow supports different processing methods, including smoking or blasting with the appropriate medium.
The Magma Block shown here is only a visual marker. Use the correct fire or lava arrangement for the desired recipe.
outlandish.ponder.create_first_power.tex: Create introduces rotational power. This is your first major step into automation.
Water wheels can generate rotational power from flowing water.
Shafts transmit that rotation between connected components.
Cogwheels transfer and redirect rotational power through machinery.
Watch rotational speed and stress capacity. Your machines need enough power to run.
outlandish.ponder.create_mixing.text_1: Mechanical Mixing combines ingredients and unlocks important processing recipes.
outlandish.ponder.create_mixing.text_10: A Blaze Burner is useful for recipes requiring heated or superheated mixing conditions.
outlandish.ponder.create_mixing.text_11: Use JEI to inspect our pack-specific mixing recipes and the required processing conditions.
outlandish.ponder.create_mixing.text_12: Mechanical Mixing is part of the preparation for more advanced industrial components.
outlandish.ponder.create_mixing.text_2: Step 1: Place a Basin to hold the mixing ingredients.
outlandish.ponder.create_mixing.text_3: Step 2: Install a Mechanical Mixer two blocks above the Basin.
outlandish.ponder.create_mixing.text_4: The mixer head hangs into the space above the Basin during operation.
outlandish.ponder.create_mixing.text_5: Step 3: Supply rotational power through the correctly aligned drivetrain.
outlandish.ponder.create_mixing.text_6: This cogwheel is a placement illustration. Confirm the mixer is actually receiving rotation.
outlandish.ponder.create_mixing.text_7: Mixers need enough rotational speed to operate. Gear ratios can increase rotational speed.
outlandish.ponder.create_mixing.text_8: Add the recipe ingredients to the Basin through manual insertion or suitable automation.
outlandish.ponder.create_mixing.text_9: Some recipes require heating. Place a valid heat source below the Basin when JEI specifies one.
outlandish.ponder.create_steam.text_1: Steam power is a major milestone on the road toward industrial technology.
outlandish.ponder.create_steam.text_2: Steam engines rely on a boiler setup with an adequate water supply.
outlandish.ponder.create_steam.text_3: Heating supports boiler operation. Larger setups demand stronger heat sources.
outlandish.ponder.create_steam.text_4: Steam engines convert boiler output into rotational power.
outlandish.ponder.create_steam.text_5: Steam and mechanical progression support your transition toward GTCEu industry.
outlandish.ponder.create_to_gtceu.text_1: Outlandish Revelations connects your Create workshop to the beginnings of GTCEu industry.
Progress through steam processing, then prepare the equipment needed for LV electrical power.
outlandish.ponder.create_to_gtceu.text_2: Create introduces rotational power and mechanical automation.
outlandish.ponder.create_to_gtceu.text_3: Create steam technology is an important progression milestone.
outlandish.ponder.create_to_gtceu.text_4: GTCEu uses its own steam boilers to power compatible steam machinery.
outlandish.ponder.create_to_gtceu.text_5: The machines shown are progression milestones, not a connected power network.
outlandish.ponder.create_to_gtceu.text_6: Create rotational stress and GTCEu steam are different power systems.
outlandish.ponder.create_to_gtceu.text_7: Use the Create workshop to prepare components required by the pack-specific progression.
outlandish.ponder.create_to_gtceu.text_8: A GTCEu boiler needs fuel and a water supply. Connect its steam output to suitable machines.
outlandish.ponder.create_to_gtceu.text_9: Check JEI for the exact components required to establish your first GTCEu processing line.
outlandish.ponder.dimensional_gates.head: Outlandish: Unlocking the Dimensions
outlandish.ponder.dimensional_gates.text: Dimension access in Outlandish Revelations is earned through boss progression.
Summon and defeat the Warden to earn Nether access for your FTB team.
Later, summon and defeat the Wither to unlock the End for your team.
Entering the End unlocks the path toward Twilight Forest.
These are team progression milestones. Follow the Dimensionality quests for each unlock.
outlandish.ponder.end_and_final_boss.tex: After unlocking the Nether, your next dimensional challenge is the Wither.
The Ender Dragon awaits after the Wither milestone.
Entering the End unlocks your path to the Twilight Forest.
Draconic Evolution provides powerful late-game equipment for the challenges ahead.
Your ultimate challenge is the Hovering Inferno in the Incendium Nether.
The Hovering Inferno has no special summoning gate. Prepare for a difficult final fight.
Step 1: Place one Soul Sand block at the bottom center.
Step 2: Add three Soul Sand blocks horizontally across the top to form a T.
Step 3: Place a Wither Skeleton Skull above the left arm.
Step 4: Place another skull above the right arm.
The third skull completes the structure and summons the Wither. Make sure you are prepared!
This is the correct Wither summoning formation: four Soul Sand blocks and three Wither Skeleton Skulls.
In Outlandish Revelations, a qualifying FTB team member must summon and defeat the Wither to unlock End access.
Summon it in a safe, open area with enough room for the Wither to form and fight.
outlandish.ponder.ev_industry.text_1: Extreme Voltage brings together advanced metallurgy, chemistry and automation.
outlandish.ponder.ev_industry.text_2: Higher-tier machines require more advanced materials and increasingly expensive components.
outlandish.ponder.ev_industry.text_3: Fluid handling becomes essential. Store chemicals and byproducts without mixing incompatible streams.
outlandish.ponder.ev_industry.text_4: Organize intermediate materials for production chains containing many dependent recipes.
outlandish.ponder.ev_industry.text_5: EV operates at a nominal 2048 EU/t. Upgrade your power infrastructure before connecting EV equipment.
outlandish.ponder.ev_industry.text_6: Check JEI for the required machine tier, EU/t, duration, fluids and circuit configurations.
outlandish.ponder.ev_industry.text_7: Do not assume one machine can process every recipe simply because its voltage tier is high enough.
outlandish.ponder.ev_industry.text_8: Automation should minimize manual transfers and prevent output bottlenecks.
outlandish.ponder.ev_industry.text_9: Your EV production infrastructure prepares the materials and components for IV.
outlandish.ponder.factory_automation.tex: A good factory connects many processing stages into one reliable system.
Always leave a way to access machines manually for repairs, upgrades and troubleshooting.
Start by organizing raw materials in accessible storage.
Step 1: Send suitable materials into the correct processing machine.
Step 2: Route compatible intermediates into later processing stages.
This is a processing diagram, not a direct machine-to-machine transfer connection.
Use proper item transport, machine auto-output settings and filters to prevent incorrect routing.
Keep fluid transport separate from item transport and provide sufficient output storage.
Plan each stage around its actual recipe speed. A slow machine can hold up the whole production line.
AE2 becomes particularly useful once large numbers of components and recipes must be managed.
outlandish.ponder.gt_chemistry.text_1: Chemistry transforms basic resources into increasingly complex industrial materials.
outlandish.ponder.gt_chemistry.text_10: Chemistry becomes important for advanced machinery, circuits and our cross-mod progression systems.
outlandish.ponder.gt_chemistry.text_2: Fluids are essential processing ingredients. Their type and amount must match the recipe.
outlandish.ponder.gt_chemistry.text_3: Chemical reactors combine materials and fluids under specific processing conditions.
outlandish.ponder.gt_chemistry.text_4: Electrolyzers and other processing machines can separate or transform materials.
outlandish.ponder.gt_chemistry.text_5: The displayed blocks are teaching markers, not a working chemical production line.
outlandish.ponder.gt_chemistry.text_6: JEI shows which machine processes a chemical recipe and which inputs are required.
outlandish.ponder.gt_chemistry.text_7: Follow the chemistry quest chapters through LV, MV, HV, EV and IV.
outlandish.ponder.gt_chemistry.text_8: Some processes depend on materials or circuits that require earlier metallurgy milestones.
outlandish.ponder.gt_chemistry.text_9: Plan fluid storage, intermediate products and byproduct extraction before automating complex chains.
outlandish.ponder.gt_machine_io.text_1: Industrial automation combines item transport, fluid handling and electrical power.
outlandish.ponder.gt_machine_io.text_2: Start with materials waiting to enter your processing system.
outlandish.ponder.gt_machine_io.text_3: Move materials toward your machine using compatible transport and configured input sides.
outlandish.ponder.gt_machine_io.text_4: This furnace represents a processing machine. Use the actual GTCEu machine in your factory.
outlandish.ponder.gt_machine_io.text_5: Open a GTCEu machine interface to inspect its item slots, fluid tanks and power requirements.
outlandish.ponder.gt_machine_io.text_6: Configure automatic item input and output where supported by the machine.
outlandish.ponder.gt_machine_io.text_7: For fluid recipes, connect compatible pipes or tanks to the correct fluid input and output.
outlandish.ponder.gt_machine_io.text_8: Some recipes produce byproducts. Provide storage or extraction so outputs cannot block processing.
outlandish.ponder.gt_machine_io.text_9: If a machine refuses to run, check its recipe, energy supply, input items, fluid amounts and output space.
outlandish.ponder.gt_multiblock_operatio: A multiblock is more than a controller. It needs a correctly formed structure and operational connections.
Recipe requirements and power demand can exceed those of a lower-tier multiblock.
For troubleshooting, check structure formation, recipe inputs, voltage, amperage and output capacity.
The controller determines which multiblock machine you are building.
Casings and internal components form the required structure.
Hatches and buses provide ways for power, items and fluids to enter or leave.
These blocks illustrate component roles. They are not a valid GTCEu multiblock structure.
Use the GTCEu multiblock viewer in JEI for the exact structure and permitted component locations.
Energy hatches accept electrical power. Item buses and fluid hatches manage ingredients and products.
The machine must form correctly before processing. Check controller status if it fails.
Some multiblocks require special coils, temperature limits or other operating conditions.
outlandish.ponder.gt_steam.text_1: Your first GTCEu technology uses steam before electrical machines take over.
outlandish.ponder.gt_steam.text_2: Fuel and water are essential resources for producing steam.
outlandish.ponder.gt_steam.text_3: Steam machinery introduces more structured material processing.
outlandish.ponder.gt_steam.text_4: Processing efficiency and material preparation become increasingly important.
outlandish.ponder.gt_steam.text_5: The questbook explains your steam boiler and machine sequence. JEI shows exact recipes.
outlandish.ponder.gt_steam_to_electric.t: Steam power begins your industrial journey. Electrical machinery is the next major milestone.
A steam boiler converts fuel and water into steam for compatible machines.
Steam needs suitable fluid pipes. This copper block marks the connection.
Your steam-powered workshop prepares the materials and components for electricity.
Electric machines do not accept steam as their normal EU power supply.
Build the generators, cables and electrical machines required by your LV quest progression.
Check JEI for Outlandish Revelations recipes. Some prerequisites differ from standard GTCEu.
Create mechanical and steam technology are part of this transition. Neither replaces your GTCEu progression.
outlandish.ponder.gt_voltage_safety.head: GTCEu: Voltage and Electrical Safety
outlandish.ponder.gt_voltage_safety.text: GTCEu electricity is based on voltage tiers and amperage. Both must be considered.
Always inspect machine tooltips, cable ratings and generator outputs before connecting power.
Low Voltage: LV machines are your first electrical processing stage.
Medium Voltage: MV unlocks more demanding equipment and processes.
High Voltage: HV introduces higher electrical requirements.
Progression continues through EV and IV. Each tier requires properly rated electrical infrastructure.
Voltage is the electrical potential delivered to a machine. Amperage represents the amount of current transferred.
A cable must tolerate both the voltage and the amperage moving through it.
Excessive voltage can destroy equipment. Overloaded cables may also fail.
Transformers change voltage and available amperage. They do not create free energy.
outlandish.ponder.gtceu_lv_power.text_1: The next milestone is Low Voltage electricity. Steam and electric machinery use different power systems.
outlandish.ponder.gtceu_lv_power.text_2: Step 1: Build an appropriate LV power generator using the current pack recipes.
outlandish.ponder.gtceu_lv_power.text_3: Step 2: Route energy through GTCEu cables rated for the voltage and amperage.
outlandish.ponder.gtceu_lv_power.text_4: Step 3: Connect a compatible LV machine to the power network.
outlandish.ponder.gtceu_lv_power.text_5: The three blocks shown here are markers, not functional GTCEu machines or cables.
outlandish.ponder.gtceu_lv_power.text_6: Always verify the output voltage of the generator and the input rating of the machine.
outlandish.ponder.gtceu_lv_power.text_7: GTCEu voltage progression continues through MV, HV, EV and IV.
outlandish.ponder.gtceu_lv_power.text_8: The industrial quest chapters guide which machine tiers become available next.
outlandish.ponder.gtceu_steam_boiler.tex: GTCEu introduces steam machinery before the electrical voltage ladder.
Step 1: Position a Low Pressure Solid Fuel Boiler.
Step 2: The boiler needs a continuous water supply. This water block is only a visual reminder.
Step 3: Solid-fuel boilers require suitable fuel. Supply it through the boiler interface.
Step 4: Connect compatible fluid pipes to move generated steam toward machines.
The copper block marks where a pipe connection belongs; it is not itself a pipe.
Steam machines need sufficient steam supply to keep processing materials.
Once you can reliably generate steam, begin ore grinding, forging and material processing.
outlandish.ponder.hv_industry.text_1: High Voltage introduces more demanding materials, recipes and processing systems.
outlandish.ponder.hv_industry.text_2: Advanced metallurgy increasingly depends on blast processing and suitable heating conditions.
outlandish.ponder.hv_industry.text_3: Expand your electrical network for correctly rated HV machines and processing equipment.
outlandish.ponder.hv_industry.text_4: Prepare input and output automation for processes that consume many intermediate materials.
outlandish.ponder.hv_industry.text_5: HV operates at a nominal 512 EU/t. A higher tier brings additional energy requirements.
outlandish.ponder.hv_industry.text_6: For blast processing, sufficient voltage alone may not be enough. Check required coil temperature.
outlandish.ponder.hv_industry.text_7: Use the GTCEu JEI structure viewer to inspect the required multiblock layout and components.
outlandish.ponder.hv_industry.text_8: Keep metallurgy and chemistry working together. New metals often require several processing stages.
outlandish.ponder.hv_industry.text_9: Build reserves of circuits, alloys, fluids and specialized components before advancing to EV.
outlandish.ponder.iv_industry.text_1: Insane Voltage is the advanced industrial milestone on the road toward the endgame.
outlandish.ponder.iv_industry.text_10: The final challenges of Outlandish Revelations require more than machinery. Prepare for the ultimate battles.
outlandish.ponder.iv_industry.text_2: Advanced metallurgy provides specialized materials for the most demanding equipment.
outlandish.ponder.iv_industry.text_3: Advanced electrical machines require infrastructure capable of delivering IV power.
outlandish.ponder.iv_industry.text_4: Late-game technology connects industrial processing with major progression milestones.
outlandish.ponder.iv_industry.text_5: IV operates at a nominal 8192 EU/t. Plan generation, cables and power demand carefully.
outlandish.ponder.iv_industry.text_6: Complex recipes may depend on multiple earlier machines, materials and chemical processes.
outlandish.ponder.iv_industry.text_7: Keep earlier voltage tiers operational. They remain useful for producing lower-tier components.
outlandish.ponder.iv_industry.text_8: Use JEI to inspect processing requirements and GTCEu multiblock structures.
outlandish.ponder.iv_industry.text_9: Your industrial infrastructure supports advanced space systems, magic integrations and Draconic Evolution.
outlandish.ponder.lv_industry.header: LV Industry: Your First Electric Factory
outlandish.ponder.lv_industry.text_1: Welcome to Low Voltage. You have reached the first stage of electric industry.
outlandish.ponder.lv_industry.text_2: Begin by organizing the ore and dust processing you established during the Steam Age.
outlandish.ponder.lv_industry.text_3: Create an electrical supply capable of powering LV machines at the correct voltage.
outlandish.ponder.lv_industry.text_4: Your first electric machines expand what you can process and automate.
outlandish.ponder.lv_industry.text_5: LV operates at a nominal 32 EU/t. Check each recipe for its actual power requirement.
outlandish.ponder.lv_industry.text_6: Build a reliable supply of cables, circuits, motors and machine components.
outlandish.ponder.lv_industry.text_7: Separate raw materials, intermediate products and finished components into organized storage.
outlandish.ponder.lv_industry.text_8: Some recipes still require steam-era equipment. Do not dismantle useful machines too early.
outlandish.ponder.lv_industry.text_9: Your next objective is to prepare the materials and infrastructure needed for MV.
outlandish.ponder.mechanical_workshop.te: Learn how rotational power moves from a generator into mechanical processing.
Step 1: Begin with a Water Wheel. Add flowing water in the real build.
Step 2: Connect aligned shafts to distribute rotational power.
Step 3: Cogwheels are useful when redirecting rotation into other components.
Step 4: A Mechanical Press operates over a Depot or compatible processing setup.
A press must also receive rotational power through a correctly aligned drive.
Use JEI to find your pack-specific pressing recipes, especially plates and early components.
You can extend this workshop with mixers, belts, crushers and automated item handling.
outlandish.ponder.mv_industry.text_1: Medium Voltage expands your factory, but also increases its energy demands.
outlandish.ponder.mv_industry.text_2: Preserve useful LV machinery. Lower-tier recipes may still be economical to run there.
outlandish.ponder.mv_industry.text_3: Introduce correctly rated MV generators, cables and processing equipment.
outlandish.ponder.mv_industry.text_4: Build dedicated intermediate storage so one processing stage cannot block the entire factory.
outlandish.ponder.mv_industry.text_5: MV operates at a nominal 128 EU/t, four times the LV voltage.
outlandish.ponder.mv_industry.text_6: A recipe that requires MV cannot simply be run in an LV machine by supplying more amperage.
outlandish.ponder.mv_industry.text_7: Expand your chemical and metallurgical processing alongside your electrical infrastructure.
outlandish.ponder.mv_industry.text_8: Plan fluid transport early. Chemistry increasingly depends on reliable fluid handling.
outlandish.ponder.mv_industry.text_9: Keep the production chains for circuits and machine components organized for HV.
outlandish.ponder.nether_warden_gate.tex: The Nether is not immediately accessible in Outlandish Revelations.
Incendium expands the Nether with additional biomes, structures and powerful enemies.
Prepare for a dangerous encounter in the Deep Dark.
Your progression requires summoning and defeating the Warden.
The Warden is extremely dangerous. Prepare equipment and supplies before attempting the fight.
The pack uses a progression condition that requires the Warden to be summoned and killed by a qualifying team member.
Defeating the Warden satisfies the intended prerequisite for unlocking Nether access.
The blocks are progression symbols, not a Warden summoning structure or a functional portal.
The Nether unlock is designed to apply to your FTB team after the required kill is recorded.
Visit the Nether progression chapter to confirm your objective before entering.
outlandish.ponder.ore_processing.text_1: Ore processing is one of the foundations of industrial progression.
outlandish.ponder.ore_processing.text_2: Begin by collecting ores. Different materials have different processing chains.
outlandish.ponder.ore_processing.text_3: The LV Macerator processes compatible materials into dusts and other products.
outlandish.ponder.ore_processing.text_4: Collect processed materials and leave enough room for additional outputs.
outlandish.ponder.ore_processing.text_5: The machine arrangement shown here illustrates workflow. Configure the real input and output connections.
outlandish.ponder.ore_processing.text_6: Open JEI to discover the correct macerating recipe for your ore.
outlandish.ponder.ore_processing.text_7: Some processing chains include additional crushing, washing or separation stages.
outlandish.ponder.ore_processing.text_8: More advanced machines can improve recovery or unlock different byproducts.
outlandish.ponder.ore_processing.text_9: Automate frequently used ores first. Iron, copper and other common materials are constantly needed.
Your Seared Melter was only the beginning. Build a larger smeltery to melt and cast materials.
Step 1: Build a solid floor from valid Seared blocks.
Step 2: Build walls around the perimeter. Leave the center hollow.
Step 3: Put the Smeltery Controller into an exterior wall.
Step 4: Install a Seared Fuel Tank in the wall. Supply the appropriate fuel.
Step 5: Replace another wall block with a Seared Drain.
Step 6: Attach a faucet to the drain and put a Casting Table underneath it.
This demonstration shows the basic shell. Check the controller for valid structure formation.
As you progress, expand the smeltery and add more casting stations.
outlandish.ponder.the_beginning.text_1: Welcome! Progression here is built around mastering tools, machinery, magic and exploration.
outlandish.ponder.the_beginning.text_2: Begin with basic resources. Stone and ore processing lay the foundation.
outlandish.ponder.the_beginning.text_3: Gather ores carefully. Your first processing methods will lead into steam technology.
outlandish.ponder.the_beginning.text_4: Use JEI to study recipes and follow the questbook for your next objectives.
outlandish.ponder.the_beginning.text_5: Your first goal: establish a workshop and prepare for mechanical and steam power.
outlandish.ponder.tinkers_casting.text_1: Casting turns molten metals into useful components for your workshop.
Right-click the faucet to pour molten material into a valid casting target.
Allow the material to finish cooling before collecting the result.
Check JEI for casts, fluid amounts and our modified Tinkers progression recipes.
outlandish.ponder.tinkers_casting.text_2: Begin with a Seared Drain in a valid smeltery wall. This block marks its location.
outlandish.ponder.tinkers_casting.text_3: The Seared Drain allows molten fluids to leave your smeltery.
outlandish.ponder.tinkers_casting.text_4: Attach a Seared Faucet to the outside of the drain, facing the casting station.
outlandish.ponder.tinkers_casting.text_5: Position a Casting Table immediately below the faucet.
outlandish.ponder.tinkers_casting.text_6: Casting Tables use the appropriate casts to produce components such as ingots and tool parts.
outlandish.ponder.tinkers_casting.text_7: The faucet must point outward from the drain and toward the casting surface.
outlandish.ponder.tinkers_casting.text_8: A Casting Basin is used for larger casting recipes, including compatible metal blocks.
outlandish.ponder.tinkers_casting.text_9: Move the basin beneath a suitable faucet when you want to use it.
outlandish.ponder.tinkers_toolmaking.tex: Tinkers tools are assembled from parts. The material of each part affects the finished tool.
Check JEI and the Tinkers Workshop quests for our custom progression and available tools.
Step 1: Use a Part Builder to manufacture compatible tool parts from appropriate materials.
Select the part pattern and provide the required materials.
Different tool types require different combinations of parts.
Step 2: Use a Tinker Station to assemble supported tools from the parts you have prepared.
Choose the tool you want to assemble and insert the matching parts.
A tool can combine materials with different properties, letting you balance durability and performance.
As you advance, molten-metal casting provides another way to manufacture tool components.
Our pack uses Tinkers as the main early and midgame toolmaking system.
outlandish.ponder.tinkers_workshop.text_: Tinkers is your main early and midgame path for crafting and improving tools.
Start with the basic workshop and tool-building systems.
Melting and casting open the way to more advanced equipment.
The casting workshop uses materials tied to Create progression.
Follow the Tinkers Workshop quests. Use JEI for the exact casting and tool recipes.
outlandish.ponder.voltage_ladder.text_1: Electric machinery introduces voltage tiers, cable limits, and energy management.
outlandish.ponder.voltage_ladder.text_2: LV and MV establish the foundation of your electrical industry.
outlandish.ponder.voltage_ladder.text_3: HV and EV unlock more demanding processing and chemistry.
outlandish.ponder.voltage_ladder.text_4: IV brings the advanced machinery needed for later progression.
outlandish.ponder.voltage_ladder.text_5: Match your generators, cables and machines to the correct voltage. Higher is not automatically safer!
